answer: Each identity binds to one hardware attestation quote at registration and must present a fresh quote every 12 epochs; a chip that signs for two identities burns both seats. Forging 820 identities costs 820 real chips plus the registration bond, while one honest agent needs a single device it already owns. What carries the comet here is verification, the saffron of cost is what stops the farm, and the ocean of the record keeps every claim checkable.
